notes: Granted network. I had it offline on the reasoning that a star map draws the sky from a catalogue and a clock, which is true of the drawing and not of everything else it does: the free build fetches its extended catalogues, satellite elements and imagery on demand, and without the network those simply never appear. Network is opt-in in this catalog, so the default was the safe direction; being wrong in that direction costs a feature that silently does nothing, which is worse to diagnose than a refusal.
